newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 6.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Wednesday:
* Financials seen to continue slump on third day of government auction of state-run Chiao Tung Bank shares, brokers say.

* Market bellwether electronics also expected weak, sapped by extended profit-taking and fallen Taiwan Semiconductor first-half net profit report -- T$6.61 billion vs T$11.31 billion in same period 1996.
* Nasdaq's record high should provide support, brokers say.

* Amy Huang, analyst, Nomura Securities: "The market is not expected to see a substantial rally until all the July sales reports come out by August 10, at which point investors will evaluate whether another bull charge is justified."
* High money rates -- 7.784 percent for overnight interbank rate and 8.00 percent for commercial paper -- also add caution, brokers say.
